name: todo
title: Todo tools
description: Durable todo_read/todo_write for a trusted owner and thread. Host table agevexTodos; at most 100 unique items, 100-character ids, 4000-character text and 32 KiB UTF-8 per list. Core receipts deduplicate tool calls.
docs: Merge todoTables from the installed schema snippet into convex/schema.ts. Pass internal.agevexTools.todoState to createTodoTools and register on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. No schema is overwritten. See /docs/tools/todo.
